splinePreview: function preview(n,segments,vertices=[]){const keys=FrameSpline.componentVertices(n.splineData,selection(n.nativeHash)),handles=[...selection(n.nativeHash)].filter(k=>k.startsWith('h:')||k.startsWith('free:')).map(k=>k.replace(/^free:/,'f:'));if(FrameMorph.previewEdit(n,[...keys,...handles],FrameMorphMath.points(n.splineData)))return;for(let p=n;p;p=node(p.parent)){liveVersions.set(p,(liveVersions.get(p)||0)+1);let changes=liveChanges.get(p);if(!changes)liveChanges.set(p,changes=new Set());for(const id of segments)changes.add(id);const state=states.get(p.id);if(state)state.signature=null;}window.frameEngine.previewSplineData(n.nativeHash,n.splineData,segments,vertices);refresh();request();}
